invariant: Validation follows the selected command execution path: participant single-line COLOR is one HColorSet token, notes/boxes use Colors, and unused captures are not executed. All four HColorSet gradient separators remain valid and visibly unsupported if not painted faithfully.
causal_divergence: Generic Colors validation accepts participant composite tokens that Java rejects. Warning detection omits the hyphen gradient separator. Participant execution returns early for an already-declared CODE; multiline participant execution never reads COLOR, so imposing uniform validation also risks rejecting valid programs.
planned_change: Dispatch validation by command class and command execution state. Preserve valid direct HColorSet gradients; reject whole participant composite tokens via No such color, retain note/box Colors behavior and ignore unused multiline participant COLOR. Where complete participant identity is recoverable, preserve existing-participant early return. Include hyphen in unsupported-gradient reporting.
perturbation_axes: same color token on participant versus note/box and multiline participant
four gradient separators and fresh versus repeated participant identity
source_correction: The request phrase composite or gradient participant colours fail is too broad: HColorSet.parseColor explicitly accepts - / | and backslash gradients with valid parseSimpleColor endpoints; the independent checker confirms hyphen gradients are Java-valid. No valid grammar narrowing is planned.
